title: Let It Snow
description: Find a code on an infinite diagonal grid using modular exponentiation.
writeup:
## Approach

Two steps: convert the (row, col) position to a 1-based sequence index, then compute the code at that index.

## Part 1

The grid fills along diagonals: position (r, c) is on diagonal `r+c-1`. The sequence index is `diag*(diag-1)/2 + col`, using the triangular number formula.

Each code is the previous one multiplied by 252533 mod 33554393. So code(n) = `20151125 * 252533^(n-1) mod 33554393`. Rather than iterating millions of times, we use Python's built-in modular exponentiation (`pow(base, exp, mod)`) which runs in O(log n) via repeated squaring.
